title: Vickers Wellington HF613
memorial_details: Bronze plaque attached to a drystone wall. Inscription in raised upright capital lettering.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/ SGT. J .D. KESTER,/ SGT. R. F. CAIRNS,/ SGT. W. J. HACKETT,/ SGT. B. E. WILKINSON (R.C.A.F.)/ AND/ SGT. W. A. MARWOOD (R.A.F.)/ WHO DIED ON ACTIVE SERVICE/ IN A WELLINGTON/ BOMBER CRASH/ 15TH FEBRUARY 1943/ IN HOPE PARISH.
